name: ProductNow
description:
ProductNow turns prototype feedback into product decisions that teams can trace. The ProductNow MCP server gives Claude secure access to your ProductNow workspace, enabling it to search, retrieve, create, and update ProductNow content while respecting your existing workspace permissions.

With the ProductNow MCP server, Claude can:
* Search, fetch, and create ProductNow documents.
* Read document versions, chat history, comment threads, and attached files.
* Ask ProductNow document and template agents to draft or edit content.
* Create and manage document templates, and organize documents into folders.
* Participate in document reviews by commenting, replying, and reacting to discussions, and update document status as work progresses.

ProductNow MCP uses OAuth 2.1 for authentication and connects directly to your ProductNow workspace, helping Claude support product planning, requirements, customer feedback, prototype reviews, and team collaboration without leaving your existing workflow.

Learn more about ProductNow at https://productnow.ai or sign in to your workspace at https://app.productnow.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ProductNow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ProductNow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.productnow-prod.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ProductNow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ProductNow lists 33 MCP tools, including change_document_version_status, create_document, create_document_comment, create_folder, create_template, create_template_note, create_template_section, delete_template, delete_template_section, edit_template, edit_template_section, and edit_template_version.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ProductNow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ProductNow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
ProductNow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ProductNow is developed by ProductNow Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
